quest.title: A Fishy Flavor
quest.description: "Neko," the Asase Shrine's provisionary head priestess, seems to be troubled about something...

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Ah, it's you. Those little ones have run off yet again. They really are growing most rebellious...

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Now that you have hung those metal balls around the shrine, I believe that they will be able to find their way back.

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: It is not a bad thing, perhaps, for them to go a little wild outside, lest they make a fool of themselves in front of the humans and disgrace the shrine.

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: But if they should go overboard and go hungry from when the sun hangs high to when the moon comes up... That would not be good either.

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Well then, please bring these fish to those little rascals so that they may eat.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let's pass our map to Neko to mark out, shall we?

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Mmm, it seems that you do not lack comprehension...

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Alright then. Go now, and quickly. I have matters of the shrine to attend to yet.

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Mmm, it seems that you do not lack comprehension...

choices.text: Need us to go look for them?

talks.objective: Feed the little cats with Fish

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Bring those fish to the little ones, and quickly. I have matters of the shrine to attend to yet.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: You have returned. Have you fed those rascals?

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Good, good. You have my thanks. Without your aid, those children would have played and played... and then they would have gone hungry outside.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: *sigh* What a bunch of disobedient children. How will they be fit to receive the people coming to the shrine this way...

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: You have returned. It is strange. Those children suddenly all came back, and they looked mighty frightened, too.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Did they meet some hairy churls outside, the ones with the sticks?

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Still, they did come back... Wait, what is the matter with you?

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: ...You... unfathomable human! What possessed you to do that?

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: You could simply have played with these children the normal way...

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Meow! No wonder they were so frightened... You must go and comfort them.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Really, now. I suppose it was a bit much to ask for all humans to be like Hibiki...
